name: FOSSSoc : FOSS - Season of Commits
description:
FOSS TKMCE presents FOSSSoC -FOSS Season of commits- a two-month open-source challenge to learn, contribute, and compete for a share of the ₹5,000 prize pool! 🚀

How to Contribute

Contribute to our official repository and earn points through:

Idea Implementations - Bring new features to life.
Bug Fixes - Identify and fix issues.
Documentation - Improve project guides and documentation.

Earn points for your contributions, track weekly leaderboard updates, and compete for the top spot!
